response:
Assuming you meant **"how many minutes are there in one full day"**:

There are **1,440 minutes** in one full day ($24\text{ hours} \times 60\text{ minutes/hour} = 1,440\text{ minutes}$).

*(Note: On days when Daylight Saving Time starts or ends, a calendar day can be 23 hours / **1,380 minutes** or 25 hours / **1,500 minutes** long.)*
